title: Rate Lock Commitment Dispute Filing and Response Time Limits
content:
For every **Rate Lock Commitment** product, Larkspur Home Lending accepts lock disputes for a set number of business days. The lock desk then decides each dispute within a set number of business days.

| Rate Lock Commitment product | Dispute filing window (business days after the disputed event) | Lock desk decision time (business days) |
|---|---|---|
| Larkspur 15-Day Rate Lock | 10 | 5 |
| Larkspur 30-Day Rate Lock | 10 | 5 |
| Larkspur 45-Day Rate Lock | 10 | 5 |
| Larkspur 60-Day Rate Lock | 10 | 5 |
| Larkspur 90-Day Rate Lock | 10 | 5 |
| Larkspur 120-Day Extended Rate Lock | 10 | 5 |
| Larkspur 180-Day New Construction Rate Lock | 10 | 5 |

- **Filing window**: the business days after the disputed event within which a dispute is accepted. The disputed event is either the lock confirmation or the disputed pricing entry.
- **Decision time**: the business days within which the lock desk decides a dispute.

The figures are the same for every product: 10 business days to file and 5 business days to decide.
